title: Update error dialogs to be more helpful
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary We have some error states that will require manual page reloads. In its current state, it's not very obvious for the user what to do, e.g.: This should probably be updated to something like: > Connection timed out. Please try reloading the app to re-establish the connection. If the problem persists, please contact the app builder. Same for other error dialogs. ### Why? _No response_ ### How? _No response_ ### Additional Context _No response_
